COMPRESS-197.label: I
COMPRESS-197.reason: This is tar parsing/reading of malformed octal header data, not tar writing or PAX header generation. Different failure point and mechanism.

COMPRESS-200.label: R
COMPRESS-200.reason: Strong overlap in `TarArchiveOutputStream` long-name handling and round-trip behavior with PAX/GNU extended headers. Both involve writing entries whose names exceed standard tar header limits and bugs in how the output stream emits auxiliary metadata.

COMPRESS-201.label: P
COMPRESS-201.reason: Same tar entry construction/output subsystem, but the issue is about leading slashes in link names and constructor API support, not directory entries or PAX header size/write-length mismatch. Useful only as regional context.
